n-tokenized-assets.title: Tokenized stocks and RWA coins
n-tokenized-assets.summary: Coins whose metadata describes tokenized stocks or real-world assets (RWAs). @RobinhoodCrypto posted on 2026-09-08 that Robinhood Stock Tokens had reached $150M in TVL on Robinhood Chain, and the apps built around those tokens now have coins of their own: Borro.Markets (BORRO; pool created 2026-10-05; metadata "Lend, borrow and short stock tokens"), HyperDex (HYDX; created 2026-09-24; "Unified Marketplace for Tokenized Assets & RWAs") and Prism Assets (PRISM; created 2026-08-04; "a marketplace for buying, selling & tokenising real-world assets with AI"). On Solana, Tokenize Everything (EVERYTHING; pool created 2026-10-07) describes tokenized RWAs as the biggest crypto meta of the last year and a half; one 2026-10-07 post by @RaOnChain called it a scam. None of the coins is shown to be issued by or affiliated with Robinhood. Measured: four coins across all their pools; Tokenize Everything is about 84% of the 24h volume.

n-tokenized-assets.notice: @RobinhoodCrypto (2026-09-08) reported $150M in Robinhood Stock Tokens TVL on Robinhood Chain; a 2026-10-07 recap says it outlined the Stock Token cycle from minting to trading to yield. Borro.Markets (2026-10-06) says it built Uniswap v4 hooks for stock tokens, and OgeePerps (2026-10-07) says it launched power perpetuals for tokenized stocks.
n-tokenized-assets.interpretation: Robinhood Chain stock tokens are an official product, and several apps around them now have coins. The coins are not shown to be issued by or affiliated with Robinhood, and product claims are the projects' own and not verified here. EVERYTHING is a day-old Solana meme on the theme that one account called a scam.

k-tokenized.reason: EVERYTHING (Tokenize Everything, Solana), HYDX (HyperDex, "Unified Marketplace for Tokenized Assets & RWAs") and, with k-assets, BORRO (lend/borrow/short stock tokens) and PRISM (tokenising real-world assets) have metadata that names tokenized stocks or RWAs. Four coins clear the member bars (market cap $100K or more, no flag) with about $7.56M combined 24h volume against the $500K bar ($1.22M without EVERYTHING). Independent sources: @RobinhoodCrypto (2026-09-08, $150M Stock Tokens TVL on Robinhood Chain) and the 2026-10-07 recap of its Stock Token cycle post (e3:0). OGEE (power perps for tokenized stocks) fits the story but its market cap is about $63K, under the $100K bar, so it is not added yet. At the six-narrative cap it replaces Binance Intelligence (24h $567,612 at discovery, the smallest); flagged for owner judgment.

k-assets.reason: Same narrative as k-tokenized: EVERYTHING, HYDX and PRISM ("a marketplace for buying, selling & tokenising real-world assets") are three of its four coins.

k-stocks.reason: Partly folded into the tokenized stocks and RWA narrative: EVERYTHING joins it. OGEE fits the story but is under the $100K market-cap bar (deferred). STONK ("Launch tokens / Backed by stocks.") is StonkFun's own launchpad coin: the line is a tagline and no source ties it to tokenized stocks, so it stays deferred ($9.4M 24h, market cap $133M). OTC ("Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield.") is vague and no source was found; deferred.
